history_summary: Record native reference-table correspondence and complete ambiguity options for the two C1 bacterial descriptors.
history_details: Bounded taxonomy repair only. The Brucella pseudintermedia descriptor receives the native Ochrobactrum pseudintermedium reference classification (18 genomes; fraction 1.0) and the Ochrobactrum genus descriptor retains all three native ambiguity options. Preserve SRCHD05 and SRCHD06, their partial-16S identification scope, all C1 biological claims and every old event. Reference-table populations do not identify experimental stock assemblies. The pinned table has no verified upstream release label. This application and its validators do not constitute complete scientific review.
